on Wednesday it launched a new $200M share buyback program targeting 72.5M shares, or about 3.9% of its outstanding shares.
The $200M buyback is based on the company's $69.37 closing ADS price on Sept. 22, with each ADS representing 25 shares.
The program includes open-market repurchases and purchases from shareholder LetterOne, which has agreed to sell up to 32.96M shares proportionally to its existing stake.
All shares repurchased under the new program will be cancelled.
The new program increases the company's previous $100M annual buyback target announced in May 2025 and follows completion of a separate $100M program announced in November 2025.
The company has repurchased 4.46M ADSs for $227.6M since August 2024, representing about 6% of total ADSs outstanding.
Shares and ADSs held by the company represent about 7.9% of total outstanding share
